'''Poln Minor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]]. Although once a center of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and manufacturing, by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] its roles had diminished in both capacities. Poln Minor was rich in natural resources, and had a deep network of underground [[Cave/Legends|caverns]]. [[AF-two-two-seven-five]] was an intersection located below Poln Minor's surface.
